items.title_en: Mystery as dozens of defective piggy banks wash ashore in Texas
items.title_zh: 德克萨斯州数十个有缺陷的存钱罐被冲上岸之谜
items.summary_en: Officials have been left feeling a bit perplexed after a five dozen defective piggy banks were washed ashore in Texas in 2026. What do you typically find on a beach? Sand, of course, the sea and maybe a bit of seaweed. But the last thing you'd expect to see when having a dip in the water is a piggy bank your mom would put your pocket money in as a child.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年，德克萨斯州有五打有缺陷的存钱罐被冲上岸，官员们感到有点困惑。海滩上通常会发现什么？当然还有沙子、大海，也许还有一点海藻。但当你泡在水里时，你最不想看到的就是你小时候妈妈会把你的零用钱放进去的存钱罐。
